name: Apple of My Eye
summary: At Farholde Keep, Tessa Dawnbright asks you to find apples for fussy baby Emma. She hopes to make the child a mash.

sections.title: A Fussy Child
sections.body: Tessa Dawnbright is caring for baby Emma in Farholde Keep, where the child's cries ring through the keep. Tessa says her hands are full while her husband is away gathering supplies. She asks you to find fresh apples so she can make Emma a mash.

faq.answer: Tessa Dawnbright asks you to find apples for baby Emma at Farholde Keep.
Tessa hopes to make a mash for fussy baby Emma.
Tessa asks for help at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Why can't Tessa get the supplies herself?
faq.answer: Tessa says her hands are too full caring for Emma while her husband is out for supplies.

attribution: In-game quest text: Apple of My Eye
